title: Aircrew briefing to Congress: not a false hit

tellings.quote: what do you think he meant when when u they brief Congress and says we knew it was not a false hit.

plain: Military aircrew who tracked unexplained objects in 2015 later briefed Congress and said "we knew it was not a false hit," meaning the radar return was not an error. Marik von Rennenkampff raises this in a debate on the show with Mick West, a skeptic known for explaining UFO videos, and he asks West what the aircrew could have meant by it. His point is that the people who were there ruled out a sensor glitch.
